item.title: Show HN: An app to dump notes during the day and plan todos without distraction
item.summary: I have built this to-do app because none of the app give me a place where I can dump notes and tasks at the same time. Some things are only ideas, and some things I'll have to plan immediately. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49181401 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
